findings.summary: Two frozen rows are parser artifacts rather than orderable menu items: “Caesar Salad Hummus Bowl” concatenates the separately listed Hummus Bowl and Caesar Salad, and “Cheese Pizza Pepperoni Pizza” concatenates the two separate kids pizza choices.

The frozen baseline retains duplicate representations of current items: Linguine/Linguini Pomodoro, Muhamara/Muhammara, and + Warm Pita Bread/Warm Pita. One current representation is retained; the duplicate is stale extra.

Affogato, crabcake fritters, generic Ice Cream Sundae, and New York Strip Steak were not found on the current linked ordering menu or current restaurant menu PDF. They may be prior-menu or changing-special entries and require coordinator review before removal.

AYŞE's current PDF and linked Toast descriptions provide direct positive ingredient evidence but no complete allergen matrix, negative allergen claims, or cross-contact statement. Direct descriptions do not support treating generated arrays as complete. The listed mismatch rows contain one or more baseline allergen values not directly established by their current descriptions; direct positives should be retained narrowly rather than erased.

summary: AYŞE Meze Lounge identity and current menu surface are verified, but the frozen baseline has two concatenation artifacts, three duplicate/stale rows, four items absent from the current menu, and incomplete allergen-array semantics. Current restaurant-issued and restaurant-linked menu descriptions support narrow positive ingredients only; they do not provide a complete allergen matrix or cross-contact information.
coordinatorNotes: Route to Sol: discrepancy_found. Preserve direct restaurant-issued positive ingredient evidence when repairing allergen claims, but do not infer completeness, absence, or cross-contact status from the menu descriptions.
Do not delete the four missing-current-menu rows without a date/special-menu decision; the frozen source family includes changing daily and dessert menu material.
